scope: Completed private native control; final full-precision fields at exact equal physical time. Interior HST comparisons are linearly interpolated between cadence outputs. Two timesteps alone do not establish temporal order. No pulse/stability acceptance.

launch.scope: Independent actual-timestep-halving control for failed spatial-norm N24pulse; same immutable source/exe/grid/boundary/initial data. Does not itself establish stability.

case.name: finite-angular-long-N24
case.input_text:
<job>
basename=hyp

<mesh>
nx1=24
nx2=24
nx3=24
nghost=3
x1min=-1.05
x1max=1.05
x2min=-1.05
x2max=1.05
x3min=-1.05
x3max=1.05
ix1_bc=outflow

ix3_bc=outflow
ox3_bc=outflow

nx2=24
nx3=24

<time>
evolution=dynamic
integrator=rk3
cfl_number=0.4
nlim=2
tlim=0.001
ndiag=1

<z4c>
hyperboloidal=true
hyperboloidal_slicing=2
hyperboloidal_shift_driver=0.1

hyperboloidal_shift_damping=1

mass=0
lapse_pulse=0

<output1>
file_type=bin
variable=z4c
id=z4c
dt=0.0001
ghost_zones=true

<output2>
file_type=bin

id=adm
dt=0.0001

dt=0.0001

<output5>
file_type=rst
dt=0.0001

<z4c>
